rules.name: adjacent-overload-signatures
rules.description: Require that function overload signatures be consecutive

rules.name: array-type
rules.description: Require consistently using either `T[]` or `Array<T>` for arrays

rules.name: await-thenable
rules.description: Disallow awaiting a value that is not a Thenable

rules.name: ban-ts-comment
rules.description: Disallow `@ts-<directive>` comments or require descriptions after directives

rules.name: ban-tslint-comment
rules.description: Disallow `// tslint:<rule-flag>` comments

rules.name: class-literal-property-style
rules.description: Enforce that literals on classes are exposed in a consistent style

rules.name: class-methods-use-this
rules.description: Enforce that class methods utilize `this`

rules.name: consistent-generic-constructors
rules.description: Enforce specifying generic type arguments on type annotation or constructor name of a constructor call

rules.name: consistent-indexed-object-style
rules.description: Require or disallow the `Record` type

rules.name: consistent-return
rules.description: Require `return` statements to either always or never specify values

rules.name: consistent-type-assertions
rules.description: Enforce consistent usage of type assertions

rules.name: consistent-type-definitions
rules.description: Enforce type definitions to consistently use either `interface` or `type`

rules.name: consistent-type-exports
rules.description: Enforce consistent usage of type exports

rules.name: consistent-type-imports
rules.description: Enforce consistent usage of type imports

rules.name: default-param-last
rules.description: Enforce default parameters to be last

rules.name: dot-notation
rules.description: Enforce dot notation whenever possible

rules.name: explicit-function-return-type
rules.description: Require explicit return types on functions and class methods

rules.name: explicit-member-accessibility
rules.description: Require explicit accessibility modifiers on class properties and methods

rules.name: explicit-module-boundary-types
rules.description: Require explicit return and argument types on exported functions' and classes' public class methods

rules.name: init-declarations
rules.description: Require or disallow initialization in variable declarations

rules.name: max-params
rules.description: Enforce a maximum number of parameters in function definitions

rules.name: member-ordering
rules.description: Require a consistent member declaration order

rules.name: method-signature-style
rules.description: Enforce using a particular method signature syntax

rules.name: naming-convention
rules.description: Enforce naming conventions for everything across a codebase

rules.name: no-array-constructor
rules.description: Disallow generic `Array` constructors

rules.name: no-array-delete
rules.description: Disallow using the `delete` operator on array values

rules.name: no-base-to-string
rules.description: Require `.toString()` and `.toLocaleString()` to only be called on objects which provide useful information when stringified

rules.name: no-confusing-non-null-assertion
rules.description: Disallow non-null assertion in locations that may be confusing

rules.name: no-confusing-void-expression
rules.description: Require expressions of type void to appear in statement position

rules.name: no-deprecated
rules.description: Disallow using code marked as `@deprecated`

rules.name: no-dupe-class-members
rules.description: Disallow duplicate class members

rules.name: no-duplicate-enum-values
rules.description: Disallow duplicate enum member values

rules.name: no-duplicate-type-constituents
rules.description: Disallow duplicate constituents of union or intersection types

rules.name: no-dynamic-delete
rules.description: Disallow using the `delete` operator on computed key expressions

rules.name: no-empty-function
rules.description: Disallow empty functions

rules.name: no-empty-interface
rules.description: Disallow the declaration of empty interfaces

rules.name: no-empty-object-type
rules.description: Disallow accidentally using the "empty object" type

rules.name: no-explicit-any
rules.description: Disallow the `any` type

rules.name: no-extra-non-null-assertion
rules.description: Disallow extra non-null assertions

rules.name: no-extraneous-class
rules.description: Disallow classes used as namespaces

rules.name: no-floating-promises
rules.description: Require Promise-like statements to be handled appropriately

rules.name: no-for-in-array
rules.description: Disallow iterating over an array with a for-in loop

rules.name: no-generated-empty-object-type
rules.description: Disallow type operations that resolve to the "empty object" type

rules.name: no-implied-eval
rules.description: Disallow the use of `eval()`-like functions

rules.name: no-import-type-side-effects
rules.description: Enforce the use of top-level import type qualifier when an import only has specifiers with inline type qualifiers

rules.name: no-inferrable-types
rules.description: Disallow explicit type declarations for variables or parameters initialized to a number, string, or boolean

rules.name: no-invalid-this
rules.description: Disallow `this` keywords outside of classes or class-like objects

rules.name: no-invalid-void-type
rules.description: Disallow `void` type outside of generic or return types

rules.name: no-loop-func
rules.description: Disallow function declarations that contain unsafe references inside loop statements

rules.name: no-loss-of-precision
rules.description: Disallow literal numbers that lose precision

rules.name: no-magic-numbers
rules.description: Disallow magic numbers

rules.name: no-meaningless-void-operator
rules.description: Disallow the `void` operator except when used to discard a value

rules.name: no-misused-new
rules.description: Enforce valid definition of `new` and `constructor`

rules.name: no-misused-promises
rules.description: Disallow Promises in places not designed to handle them

rules.name: no-misused-spread
rules.description: Disallow using the spread operator when it might cause unexpected behavior

rules.name: no-mixed-enums
rules.description: Disallow enums from having both number and string members

rules.name: no-namespace
rules.description: Disallow TypeScript namespaces

rules.name: no-non-null-asserted-nullish-coalescing
rules.description: Disallow non-null assertions in the left operand of a nullish coalescing operator

rules.name: no-non-null-asserted-optional-chain
rules.description: Disallow non-null assertions after an optional chain expression

rules.name: no-non-null-assertion
rules.description: Disallow non-null assertions using the `!` postfix operator

rules.name: no-redeclare
rules.description: Disallow variable redeclaration

rules.name: no-redundant-type-constituents
rules.description: Disallow members of unions and intersections that do nothing or override type information

rules.name: no-require-imports
rules.description: Disallow invocation of `require()`

rules.name: no-restricted-imports
rules.description: Disallow specified modules when loaded by `import`

rules.name: no-restricted-types
rules.description: Disallow certain types

rules.name: no-shadow
rules.description: Disallow variable declarations from shadowing variables declared in the outer scope

rules.name: no-this-alias
rules.description: Disallow aliasing `this`

rules.name: no-type-alias
rules.description: Disallow type aliases

rules.name: no-unnecessary-boolean-literal-compare
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary equality comparisons against boolean literals

rules.name: no-unnecessary-condition
rules.description: Disallow conditionals where the type is always truthy or always falsy

rules.name: no-unnecessary-parameter-property-assignment
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary assignment of constructor property parameter

rules.name: no-unnecessary-qualifier
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary namespace qualifiers

rules.name: no-unnecessary-template-expression
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary template expressions

rules.name: no-unnecessary-type-arguments
rules.description: Disallow type arguments that are equal to the default

rules.name: no-unnecessary-type-assertion
rules.description: Disallow type assertions that do not change the type of an expression

rules.name: no-unnecessary-type-constraint
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary constraints on generic types

rules.name: no-unnecessary-type-conversion
rules.description: Disallow conversion idioms when they do not change the type or value of the expression

rules.name: no-unnecessary-type-parameters
rules.description: Disallow type parameters that aren't used multiple times

rules.name: no-unsafe-argument
rules.description: Disallow calling a function with a value with type `any`

rules.name: no-unsafe-assignment
rules.description: Disallow assigning a value with type `any` to variables and properties

rules.name: no-unsafe-call
rules.description: Disallow calling a value with type `any`

rules.name: no-unsafe-class-instance-assignment
rules.description: Disallow assigning non-instance values to class instance typed locations

rules.name: no-unsafe-declaration-merging
rules.description: Disallow unsafe declaration merging

rules.name: no-unsafe-enum-assignment
rules.description: Disallow assigning non-enum values to enum typed locations

rules.name: no-unsafe-enum-comparison
rules.description: Disallow comparing an enum value with a non-enum value

rules.name: no-unsafe-function-type
rules.description: Disallow using the unsafe built-in Function type

rules.name: no-unsafe-member-access
rules.description: Disallow member access on a value with type `any`

rules.name: no-unsafe-return
rules.description: Disallow returning a value with type `any` from a function

rules.name: no-unsafe-type-assertion
rules.description: Disallow type assertions that narrow a type

rules.name: no-unsafe-unary-minus
rules.description: Require unary negation to take a number

rules.name: no-unused-expressions
rules.description: Disallow unused expressions

rules.name: no-unused-private-class-members
rules.description: Disallow unused private class members

rules.name: no-unused-vars
rules.description: Disallow unused variables

rules.name: no-use-before-define
rules.description: Disallow the use of variables before they are defined

rules.name: no-useless-constructor
rules.description: Disallow unnecessary constructors

rules.name: no-useless-default-assignment
rules.description: Disallow default values that will never be used

rules.name: no-useless-empty-export
rules.description: Disallow empty exports that don't change anything in a module file

rules.name: no-var-requires
rules.description: Disallow `require` statements except in import statements

rules.name: no-wrapper-object-types
rules.description: Disallow using confusing built-in primitive class wrappers

rules.name: non-nullable-type-assertion-style
rules.description: Enforce non-null assertions over explicit type assertions

rules.name: only-throw-error
rules.description: Disallow throwing non-`Error` values as exceptions

rules.name: parameter-properties
rules.description: Require or disallow parameter properties in class constructors

rules.name: prefer-as-const
rules.description: Enforce the use of `as const` over literal type

rules.name: prefer-destructuring
rules.description: Require destructuring from arrays and/or objects

rules.name: prefer-enum-initializers
rules.description: Require each enum member value to be explicitly initialized

rules.name: prefer-find
rules.description: Enforce the use of Array.prototype.find() over Array.prototype.filter() followed by [0] when looking for a single result

rules.name: prefer-for-of
rules.description: Enforce the use of `for-of` loop over the standard `for` loop where possible

rules.name: prefer-function-type
rules.description: Enforce using function types instead of interfaces with call signatures

rules.name: prefer-includes
rules.description: Enforce `includes` method over `indexOf` method

rules.name: prefer-literal-enum-member
rules.description: Require all enum members to be literal values

rules.name: prefer-namespace-keyword
rules.description: Require using `namespace` keyword over `module` keyword to declare custom TypeScript modules

rules.name: prefer-nullish-coalescing
rules.description: Enforce using the nullish coalescing operator instead of logical assignments or chaining

rules.name: prefer-optional-chain
rules.description: Enforce using concise optional chain expressions instead of chained logical ands, negated logical ors, or empty objects

rules.name: prefer-promise-reject-errors
rules.description: Require using Error objects as Promise rejection reasons

rules.name: prefer-readonly
rules.description: Require private members to be marked as `readonly` if they're never modified outside of the constructor

rules.name: prefer-readonly-parameter-types
rules.description: Require function parameters to be typed as `readonly` to prevent accidental mutation of inputs

rules.name: prefer-reduce-type-parameter
rules.description: Enforce using type parameter when calling `Array#reduce` instead of using a type assertion

rules.name: prefer-regexp-exec
rules.description: Enforce `RegExp#exec` over `String#match` if no global flag is provided

rules.name: prefer-return-this-type
rules.description: Enforce that `this` is used when only `this` type is returned

rules.name: prefer-string-starts-ends-with
rules.description: Enforce using `String#startsWith` and `String#endsWith` over other equivalent methods of checking substrings

rules.name: prefer-ts-expect-error
rules.description: Enforce using `@ts-expect-error` over `@ts-ignore`

rules.name: promise-function-async
rules.description: Require any function or method that returns a Promise to be marked async

rules.name: related-getter-setter-pairs
rules.description: Enforce that `get()` types should be assignable to their equivalent `set()` type

rules.name: require-array-sort-compare
rules.description: Require `Array#sort` and `Array#toSorted` calls to always provide a `compareFunction`

rules.name: require-await
rules.description: Disallow async functions which do not return promises and have no `await` expression

rules.name: restrict-plus-operands
rules.description: Require both operands of addition to be the same type and be `bigint`, `number`, or `string`

rules.name: restrict-template-expressions
rules.description: Enforce template literal expressions to be of `string` type

rules.name: return-await
rules.description: Enforce consistent awaiting of returned promises

rules.name: sort-type-constituents
rules.description: Enforce constituents of a type union/intersection to be sorted alphabetically

rules.name: strict-boolean-expressions
rules.description: Disallow certain types in boolean expressions

rules.name: strict-void-return
rules.description: Disallow passing a value-returning function in a position accepting a void function

rules.name: switch-exhaustiveness-check
rules.description: Require switch-case statements to be exhaustive

rules.name: triple-slash-reference
rules.description: Disallow certain triple slash directives in favor of ES6-style import declarations

rules.name: typedef
rules.description: Require type annotations in certain places

rules.name: unbound-method
rules.description: Enforce unbound methods are called with their expected scope

rules.name: unified-signatures
rules.description: Disallow two overloads that could be unified into one with a union or an optional/rest parameter

rules.name: use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable
rules.description: Enforce typing arguments in Promise rejection callbacks as `unknown`
